prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: HLP Labs portfolio case-study scene
Input images: Image 1 is the user-approved style and composition reference; Image 2 is the approved material and line-system quality board; Image 3 is the approved hero craft benchmark.
Primary request: Create an original early sound-era rubber-hose animation cel laboratory scene. A friendly anthropomorphic clear glass research vial character stands beside a classic microscope and a shop-window display apparatus, confidently connecting research and a carefully organized public catalog. The vial points toward the microscope slide with one gloved hand while the other presents a small unlabelled display tray.
Scene/backdrop: tidy research bench inside a whimsical laboratory storefront, with glassware silhouettes, shelves, arched window, lamp, careful specimen drawers, and restrained gray-wash depth. Keep the setting unmistakably scientific and laboratory-focused, not clinical.
Style/medium: black-and-white early sound-era rubber-hose animation cel; ink black on warm paper white; soft gray wash; subtle cel grain and faint paper wear; confident uniform smooth contour; boneless hose limbs; circular joints; white gloves; pie-cut eyes; rhythmic squash and stretch. Match the visual grammar and production quality of the three references without copying their characters, brands, layouts, or lettering.
Composition/framing: exact 7:5 landscape composition intended for 1400 by 1000 pixels. The vial, microscope, and display apparatus form one balanced triangular group with clear silhouettes and comfortable crop margins. Reserve some lighter breathing room in the upper-left and keep the darkest values around the subjects.
Lighting/mood: curious, rigorous, friendly, transparent, precise.
Color palette: monochrome ink black, paper white, wash gray, soft gray, charcoal only.
Materials/textures: transparent glass indicated with sparse highlights and gray wash, enamel microscope, wood-and-glass display case, inked cel over lightly aged paper.
Constraints: scientific and laboratory context only. No humans, no needles, no injection, no body, no medicine-taking, no treatment implication, no health outcome, no medical claim. No words, no letters, no numerals, no labels, no logo, no watermark, no signature, no readable product packaging, no UI, no branded marks. No color, no gradients, no photorealism, no 3D render.
